rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering when “prime” means highest in importance.

example.english: This is the company's prime issue.
example.traditional: 呢個係公司最重要嘅問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for something that is of the highest quality, standard, or value rather than merely important.

example.traditional: 呢間餐廳用嘅係頂級食材。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jung6 ge3 hai6 deng2 kap1 sik6 coi4

rows.note: Use this when “prime” means first in a time sequence, order, or series.

example.english: The first person to sign up gets prime choice of seats.
example.traditional: 第一個報名嘅人可以優先揀位。
example.jyutping: dai6 jat1 go3 bou3 meng2 ge3 jan4 ho2 ji5 jau1 sin1 gaan2 wai2
